title: M6 actual complete solve storage specialization

spec.name: M6.ActualTransfer.actual_solve_storage
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.ActualTransfer.BP), M6.ActualTransfer.span a b < N → M6.ActualTransfer.actualSolveStorage N a b ≤ 16384*N^2*2^(M6.ActualTransfer.span a b)
spec.guidance: Use the accepted actual EuclidStorage.preprocess_storage once its gate is verified, extracting its final storage bound. The original span<N gives all polynomial degree≤N hypotheses including modulus=X^N+1. Then apply Transfer.solve_storage_bound with the actual layout value. Do not leave a supplied storage estimate as public hypothesis; do not infer space from time. Return tactic lines without leading by.
